program_name: SafePal Affiliate Program (Tapfiliate; hardware-wallet sales) + Fiat Gateway referral programme (in-app, personal)
legal_entity: Not stated on the affiliate page or the help-centre guide (SafePal; no company name or registration printed).
application_conditions: Affiliate page: sign-up through Tapfiliate (https://safepal.tapfiliate.com/programs/magento2-s1/signup/, '3 clicks to finish sign-up'); personal affiliate link with real-time tracking. Help-centre guide (updated April 11, 2024): new affiliates start at a 10% sales commission; after 100 conversion orders an affiliate may e-mail sales@safepal.com to request 20%. Commissionable products listed by code: s1, s1pro, x1, cypher, leathercase (hardware wallets and accessories only). The Fiat gateway, the Fiat24 account and the Mastercard are NOT in the commissionable list.
paid_action: Sale of SafePal hardware products through the affiliate link (affiliate page: 'Earn up to 10-20% commission from each sale'). Card sign-ups: not a paid action on the pages read. Separate Fiat Gateway referral (personal, in-app): 'indefinite commissions based on the top-up amount of your referees' — referee enters the invite code within 7 days of opening the IBAN account and tops up ≥ 100 USDC within 30 days; bank page: 'up to 40% referral commissions indefinitely on all top-up fees from referred accounts' (rate table by tier is an image, unread).
validation_conditions: Hardware: completed order through the tracked link (conversions can fail on the same network, with an ad blocker or in Brave — guide). Fiat gateway referral: invite code within 7 days + 100 USDC accumulated top-up within 30 days.

commission.model_note: Hardware sales: 10% standard, 20% negotiable after 100 orders (guide, 2024); affiliate page 'up to 10-20%'. Card/fiat gateway: not commissionable through the affiliate programme; the in-app referral pays a share (up to 40%, tier-dependent) of the referees' top-up fees — which are currently 0% per the fee article, so the economic value is unclear.
commission.tiers_note: 10% → 20% on request after 100 conversion orders (hardware). Fiat gateway referral tiers: percentages in an image (unread).

payout.method: PayPal or USDT (BEP-20) address; affiliate page: 'Receive commissions in fiat or crypto, as you like'. Fiat gateway referral rewards: claimed in-app as USDC (Arbitrum).
payout.frequency: monthly — settlement notification on the last day of the month for balances ≥ US$100, paid on the 4th of the following month (guide)

rules_note: No channel rules, brand-bidding rules or country restrictions on the pages read. Banners available 'in 15 languages' (guide). The guide is dated 2024 and may be stale versus the 2026 help-centre pages.

evidence.title: SafePal Affiliate | Earn 10-20% Commissions from Every Sale (© 2024)

Sign-up via safepal.tapfiliate.com ('3 clicks to finish sign-up'); personal affiliate link with real-time tracking. No mention of the Fiat24 card or bank account.

evidence.title: A complete guide to the SafePal Affiliate Program — SafePal Help Center (Updated April 11, 2024)
evidence.excerpt: New affiliates get 'a sales commission rate of 10%'; 20% on request after 100 conversion orders. 'We will send a settlement commission notification to affiliates whose total commission reaches US$100 on the last day of each month, and pay the commission on the 4th of the following month.' Payout via PayPal or a 'USDT (Bep20)' address. Product codes: s1, s1pro, x1, cypher, leathercase.

evidence.title: The Complete Guide of the SafePal Fiat Gateway Referral Program — SafePal Help Center (Updated July 25, 2026)
evidence.excerpt: 'Once you join the program, you will enjoy indefinite commissions based on the top-up amount of your referees.' Invite code within 7 days of account opening; referee tops up a minimum accumulated 100 USDC within 30 days; one successful referral = 1500 points; rewards claimed as '$USDC(Arbitrum)'. Rates by tier: in the tiers article (image).

evidence.title: SafePal Banking Gateway (product page)
evidence.excerpt: 'Enjoy up to 40% referral commissions indefinitely on all top-up fees from referred accounts'; footnote: referral rates 'differ between account tiers' and 'may vary and be adjusted at the discretion of SafePal and Fiat24'.

notes: Identified only — nobody contacted, no application. The publisher programme (Tapfiliate) pays on hardware-wallet sales only; the card and Fiat24 account are not commissionable, so it does not fund card referrals. The Fiat Gateway referral is a personal in-app scheme paying a share of top-up fees that are currently 0%.
